question: Which customers' accounts show unusual activity this month (November 2026)?

hops.sql: select a.id, a.customer_id, a.kind, count(t.id) as n, round(sum(case when t.amount < 0 then -t.amount else 0 end), 2) as spent, round(max(-t.amount), 2) as largest_payment, (select memo from transactions x where x.account_id = a.id order by x.amount limit 1) as largest_memo, sum(case when cast(substr(t.at, 12, 2) as int) < 6 then 1 else 0 end) as before_6am, sum(case when t.kind = 'refund' then 1 else 0 end) as refunds, count(distinct t.merchant_id) as merchants, group_concat(distinct m.name) as merchant_names from accounts a join transactions t on t.account_id = a.id join merchants m on m.id = t.merchant_id where a.customer_id in ({ids}) group by a.id
hops.note: accounts with a per-account summary: select account, count, spent, largest payment and its memo, payments before 6am, refunds, merchants from transactions grouped by account; all 100 shown to the decider at once, so it judges each account against every other
customers: join customers on customers.id = accounts.customer_id

planted: C17: six night-time card payments of ~490 to a new payee, QuickWire Ltd. C29: eleven 1-3 refunds in one afternoon from merchants never used (card testing). Decoy: C05's 48,500 transfer labelled as a house purchase completion.
